purpose: Teach: 責める/信憑/引き合い/駆け引き/特筆/計る/かねる/直近

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究で、本気で、絶対、自分を、絶対、責めることなく、絶対、前向きに、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — approach your research with absolute seriousness, no self-blame, and genuine forward momentum. That's what I'm asking of you.
lines.style: Measured authority, but warm beneath it. Leans forward slightly on 'absolute seriousness.' No performance — direct eye contact. Slight drop at the end, like setting something down carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文データの、本気で、絶対、信憑性、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm making sure the paper's data holds up completely — every detail checked. Thank you for trusting me with this.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Eyes steady. No rush in the words. Respectful but not submissive — he's making a promise, not an apology. Light breath before 'thank you.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の研究、本気で、絶対、引き合いに、絶対、出して、絶対、論じろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Build on what's been done before. Reference the past work, argue from it thoughtfully. That's the strength of your position.
lines.style: Teaching tone — not lecturing. Slight rise on 'build on what's been done' to emphasize the foundation. Measured, deliberate. The confidence of someone who has seen this work before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教官との、本気で、絶対、駆け引き、絶対、慎重に、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm being careful with how I move forward with my adviser — weighing each step. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Thoughtful and grounded. Slower pace on 'each step.' Not anxious, but attentive. The 'thank you' is genuine, not formulaic — slight warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 君の論文、本気で、絶対、特筆すべき、絶対、点、絶対、多くあるぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your paper has real strengths — genuine things worth noting. Don't undersell what you've done here.
lines.style: Firm conviction on 'real strengths.' Not flattery — clinical praise. Direct gaze. Slight pause before the last sentence, letting it land. The voice of someone who means what he says.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データ、本気で、絶対、何度も、絶対、計る作業、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've been running the measurements repeatedly — making absolutely sure every number is solid. Thank you for believing in the work.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'repeatedly' — showing the labour. Not tired, but present in the work. The 'thank you' carries the weight of shared investment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究の依頼、本気で、絶対、お断りしかねる、絶対、状況、絶対、慎重に、判断しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: You can't simply refuse collaboration requests — judge each one carefully. This is where caution becomes strategy.
lines.style: Shift to firmer advisory. Slower on 'judge each one carefully.' Not harsh, but this carries more weight than before. The voice of experience protecting someone younger. Slight drop of intensity at the very end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。直近の論文、本気で、絶対、評価いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Thank you — for seeing the work I've done and for believing it matters.
lines.style: Final statement, quieter than before. Small breath before speaking. Genuine relief underneath — he's been heard. Slight trailing-off, like he might say more but chooses not to.
